# Semantic footage smoke fixtures

`dog-outdoors.jpg` and `laptop-dashboard.jpg` are synthetic images generated
specifically for CUT's semantic-footage release tests on 2026-08-09. They do
not depict a real person, product, or trademark. They are distributed under
the repository's MIT license.

The release smoke turns each still into a short silent MP4. The two scenes are
intentionally visually and semantically different so the pinned local CLIP
backend must rank the dog clip first for the query `a dog outdoors`.
